title: Understanding DataFrame Indexing
text: The DataFrame has two columns: 'a' and 'b'. Each column has three rows indexed from $$0$$ to $$2$$.

title: Accessing DataFrame Elements
text: To access an element in a DataFrame, use the syntax df['column'][row].

title: Identify the Column and Row
text: `df['a'][1]` first selects the column `'a'`, then takes the entry at index $$1$$ of that column — so you are reading row $$1$$ of column `'a'`.

title: Find the Value
text: What is the value in column 'a' at row 1?
